data.narrative:
Eon Systems is an AI & Software company at an undisclosed stage, founded by Michael Andregg. The valuation universe consists of one public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and eight private peers, including Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition. This represents a fragmented comp set across the broad AI & Software sector.

Standard peer-median valuation proved inapplicable due to insufficient clustering. The analysis identified twelve same-sector peers in AI & Software but found zero matches meeting narrow filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables. The threshold for a reliable peer-median approach requires a minimum of three datapoints within tightly defined parameters; the filtered dataset yielded none. Falling back to an all-sector median would introduce excessive noise and obscure stage-specific and scale-specific pricing dynamics.

Without sufficient narrow-peer triangulation data or disclosed financials for Eon Systems, a defensible valuation range cannot be derived from the available information. The analysis is constrained by: (1) lack of same-stage clustering within the target's peer universe, (2) undisclosed fundraising history and current valuation, and (3) absence of revenue, burn, or growth metrics. To support a quantitative valuation, either stage-equivalent private comparables with disclosed terms or Eon Systems' own financial and operational data would be required.
